title: Standard simplicial object of an adjunction and its homotopy equivalences
statement: Let $F:\mathcal S\rightleftarrows\mathcal A:U$ be an adjunction of ordinary categories, with unit $\eta:\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal S}\to UF$ and counit $\epsilon:FU\to\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal A}$ satisfying the two triangle identities. Put $G=FU$ and $\delta=F\eta U:G\to G^2$. For $a\in\mathcal A$, the objects $X_n(a)=G^{n+1}a$, $n\geq0$, with faces $G^i\epsilon G^{n-i}$ and degeneracies $G^i\delta G^{n-i}$, form an augmented simplicial object with augmentation to $a$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object]. These constructions are natural in $a$. The augmented simplicial object $UX_\bullet(a)\to\operatorname{const}(Ua)$ is a simplicial homotopy equivalence in $\mathcal S$, and $X_\bullet(Fs)\to\operatorname{const}(Fs)$ is a simplicial homotopy equivalence in $\mathcal A$ for every $s\in\mathcal S$. Here a simplicial homotopy is the usual family of degree-raising maps satisfying the simplicial homotopy identities; for $\mathcal S=\mathrm{Set}$ it is equivalently a map $K\times\Delta[1]\to L$ with the specified endpoints, where $\Delta[1]_n=\operatorname{Hom}_\Delta([n],[1])$. In the first assertion a section in degree zero is $\eta_{Ua}:Ua\to U(F(Ua))=UGa$; in all degrees the section is obtained from it by degeneracies.

source.place: Tags 08NC (lemma-standard-simplicial), 08ND (lemma-standard-simplicial-homotopy), Situation 08N9. Here F is the left adjoint called U in the source, and U is its right adjoint called V.

proof.text: Write composites in functional order. The triangle identities give $\epsilon_{Ga}\delta_a=1_{Ga}$ and $G(\epsilon_a)\delta_a=1_{Ga}$: the first is the left-adjoint triangle at $Ua$, and the second is $F$ applied to $U\epsilon_a\circ\eta_{Ua}=1_{Ua}$. Naturality of $\eta$ at $\eta_{Ua}$ says $UF(\eta_{Ua})\eta_{Ua}=\eta_{UFUa}\eta_{Ua}$; applying $F$ gives $G(\delta_a)\delta_a=\delta_{Ga}\delta_a$. Thus $G,\epsilon,\delta$ satisfy exactly the three equations of the comonad construction.

Apply [lem-trf-comonad-simplicial-object] to $(G,\epsilon,\delta)$, whose equations were checked in step 1. It gives the stated powers, operators and augmentation in endofunctors; evaluation at $a$ gives $X_\bullet(a)$ naturally in $a$. This is the standard-resolution predicate of [def-trf-comonad-standard-resolution], with simplicial-object conventions [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object].

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-adjunction-right-image-extra-degeneracies] to this supplied resolution. Its unit maps satisfy every hypothesis of [lem-coef-simplicial-extra-degeneracy-prism], which gives a section $a_n=Z(q_n)\eta_{Ua}$, $ea=1$, and $ae\simeq1_Z$. Thus $UX_\bullet(a)\to\operatorname{const}(Ua)$ is the first homotopy equivalence with the required section: $q_0=1_{[0]}$ gives $a_0=\eta_{Ua}$, and each $q_n$ is a composite of codegeneracies. For sets, [lem-coef-extra-degeneracy-contraction] applied to the same equations gives its $\Delta[1]$ cylinder description.

source.place: Tag 08ND, lemma-standard-simplicial-homotopy, in Situation 08N9 (situation-adjoint-functors); auxiliary extra-degeneracy argument for the standard object of Tag 08NC (lemma-standard-simplicial).

proof.text: For $b=Fs$ put $v=F\eta_s$. The left triangle gives $\epsilon_bv=1_b$. Apply [lem-trf-comonad-counit-section-right-degeneracies] with $T=G$ to obtain the right extra degeneracies $t_n=G^{n+1}(v)$ of $W=X_\bullet(Fs)$. By [lem-trf-simplicial-reversal-extra-degeneracies-homotopy] they are left extra degeneracies of $W^r$, with the same augmentation and degree-zero section.

source.place: Tag 08ND, lemma-standard-simplicial-homotopy, in Situation 08N9 (situation-adjoint-functors); auxiliary extra-degeneracy argument for the standard object of Tag 08NC (lemma-standard-simplicial).

proof.text: Apply [lem-coef-simplicial-extra-degeneracy-prism] to $W^r$. Its section has $ea=1$ and its homotopy runs from $ae$ to $1_{W^r}$. By [lem-trf-simplicial-reversal-extra-degeneracies-homotopy], $a_n=W(q_n)v$ and $\widetilde H_j^n=H_{n-j}^n$ give a homotopy from $1_W$ to $ae$. To obtain parameter naturality, perform the prism applications in $\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal A,\mathcal S)$ and $\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal S,\mathcal A)$. The first extra-degeneracy node supplies its identities in the former category. For $f:s\to t$, naturality of $\eta$ gives $GF(f)F\eta_s=F\eta_t F(f)$, so the split-counit node supplies right extra degeneracies in the latter. Reversal commutes with parameter evaluation. Sections and homotopies obtained in these functor categories therefore evaluate to the required natural families.
